text: Cerveja Coral is the beer brand of the Empresa de Cervejas da Madeira (ECM), which describes itself as part of the Pestana Group; the Pestana Group's holding, Pestana International Holdings S.A., is wholly owned by Dionísio Fernandes Pestana, son of the Group's founder.
short: Coral beer is a brand of the Madeira Brewery (ECM), part of the Pestana Group, owned by Dionísio Fernandes Pestana.

source.name: ECM — Empresa de Cervejas da Madeira: Actividade (ecm.pt/empresa)
source.quote: Fazendo parte do universo do Grupo Pestana, maior grupo hoteleiro português já com forte investimento internacional
source.note: ECM's own 'Empresa' page, undated; the footer identifies the company as 'Empresa de Cervejas da Madeira, Soc. Unipessoal, LDA'. ECM's homepage lists Coral ('1.logo_coral', cervejacoral.com) among its brands.

additionalSources.name: Pestana International Holdings S.A.: Consolidated Annual Report 2022 (pestanagroup.com)
additionalSources.quote: Pestana International Holdings S.A. is the holding company and its share capital is 100% owned by Dionísio Fernandes Pestana, its President and only son of the Group’s founder.
additionalSources.note: PDF, p. 22 (general information); note 40 (p. 160) adds: 'Pestana Hotel Group is owned and controlled by Dionísio Fernandes Pestana, who owns 99,99% of the capital.'
